name: Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE)
short_description: A Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) is a team and set of practices that supports makers and administers, governs and nurtures Power Platform adoption across an organization, beyond tooling and dashboards.

evidence.quote: one buzzword, I would say is a COE as a set of excellence
we've got the powercat team is build a brilliant COE
Most organizations treat the center of excellence like a nightclub with a manual guest list.
